comments.body:
My apologies, did a little more digging, and it turns out I posted the wrong info (web translations sometimes mess with stat boost placements). Actual stats appear to be:

"Ax of Jeanne Hachette"

Leadership +2
Survival +1
Fire Fighting +1

Axe-type. One of two relics available from the War of France TH.
